description: Cycle-level thermodynamics of the ASCT/SCS couple: do succinate and succinyl-CoA cancel, and what acetate, CoA, Pi and ATP/ADP levels permit net ATP formation
code:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, math, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

R=8.314462618e-3; T=310.15; RT=R*T          # 2.579 kJ/mol
# Group-transfer bookkeeping, pH 7, 37 C (kJ/mol, hydrolysis)
dG_AcCoA, dG_SucCoA, dG_ATP = -31.4, -32.6, -30.5

# Step 1  ASCT : acetyl-CoA + succinate -> acetate + succinyl-CoA
dG_ASCT = dG_AcCoA - dG_SucCoA
# Step 2  SCS (ATP-forming): succinyl-CoA + ADP + Pi -> succinate + CoA + ATP
dG_SCS_book = dG_SucCoA - dG_ATP
# Net cycle: acetyl-CoA + ADP + Pi -> acetate + CoA + ATP   (succinate / succinyl-CoA cancel)
dG_cycle_book = dG_ASCT + dG_SCS_book
# Alternative SCS value from measured K' = 3.7 (pig heart, Cha & Parks)
dG_SCS_meas = -RT*math.log(3.7)
dG_cycle_meas = dG_ASCT + dG_SCS_meas

rows=[("ASCT step (acetyl-CoA + succinate -> acetate + succinyl-CoA)", dG_ASCT, math.exp(-dG_ASCT/RT)),
      ("SCS ATP-forming step, bookkeeping", dG_SCS_book, math.exp(-dG_SCS_book/RT)),
      ("SCS ATP-forming step, K'=3.7 measured", dG_SCS_meas, 3.7),
      ("NET ASCT/SCS cycle, bookkeeping", dG_cycle_book, math.exp(-dG_cycle_book/RT)),
      ("NET ASCT/SCS cycle, with measured SCS K'", dG_cycle_meas, math.exp(-dG_cycle_meas/RT)),
      ("ACD one step (identical net stoichiometry)", dG_cycle_book, math.exp(-dG_cycle_book/RT))]
step=pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=["reaction","dG_prime_o_kJ_per_mol","K_prime_37C"])
step.to_csv("cycle_thermodynamics_steps.csv", index=False)
print(step.to_string(index=False, float_format=lambda x: f"{x:7.3f}"))

K_LO, K_HI = math.exp(-dG_cycle_book/RT), math.exp(-dG_cycle_meas/RT)
print(f"\nNet cycle K' between {K_LO:.2f} and {K_HI:.2f};  dG'o between {dG_cycle_book:.2f} and {dG_cycle_meas:.2f} kJ/mol")
print("Net cycle contains NO succinate and NO succinyl-CoA term: both cancel.\n")

# Condition for net ATP formation by the cycle:
#   Q = (acetate/acetyl-CoA) * (CoA/Pi) * (ATP/ADP)  <  K_cycle
grid=[]
for CoA in (0.1,0.5,2.0):           # mM free CoA
    for Pi in (5.0,10.0,20.0):      # mM
        for r in (1,3,5,10):        # ATP/ADP
            for K,lab in ((K_LO,"K=1.42"),(K_HI,"K=2.33")):
                grid.append(dict(CoA_mM=CoA, Pi_mM=Pi, ATP_over_ADP=r, K_cycle=lab,
                                 max_acetate_over_acetylCoA = K/((CoA/Pi)*r)))
g=pd.DataFrame(grid); g.to_csv("cycle_acetate_threshold.csv", index=False)
piv=g[g.K_cycle=="K=2.33"].pivot_table(index=["CoA_mM","Pi_mM"],columns="ATP_over_ADP",
                                       values="max_acetate_over_acetylCoA")
print("Max permissible [acetate]/[acetyl-CoA] for net ATP formation (K'=2.33):")
print(piv.to_string(float_format=lambda x: f"{x:8.1f}"))

# Absolute organellar acetate ceiling, taking acetyl-CoA at 0.05-0.2 mM
print("\nAbsolute acetate ceiling (mM) at CoA 0.5 mM, Pi 10 mM, K'=2.33:")
for ac in (0.05,0.1,0.2):
    for r in (3,5,10):
        print(f"  acetyl-CoA {ac:4.2f} mM, ATP/ADP {r:2d}  ->  acetate < {K_HI/((0.5/10.0)*r)*ac:6.2f} mM")

# Monte Carlo over log-uniform plausible ranges (NOT Blastocystis measurements)
rng=np.random.default_rng(7)
N=200000
def lu(a,b): return np.exp(rng.uniform(np.log(a),np.log(b),N))
acet, accoa, coa, pi, ratio = lu(0.1,10.), lu(0.02,0.3), lu(0.05,2.), lu(2.,30.), lu(0.5,20.)
Q = (acet/accoa)*(coa/pi)*ratio
frac_lo, frac_hi = (Q<K_LO).mean(), (Q<K_HI).mean()
print(f"\nMonte Carlo (n={N}, log-uniform over mitochondrial literature ranges):")
print(f"  fraction of sampled states permitting net ATP formation: {frac_lo:.3f} (K=1.42) to {frac_hi:.3f} (K=2.33)")
# which variable dominates? Spearman of log terms vs feasibility
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
for nm,v in [("acetate/acetyl-CoA",acet/accoa),("CoA/Pi",coa/pi),("ATP/ADP",ratio)]:
    rho,_=spearmanr(np.log(v),(Q<K_HI).astype(float))
    print(f"  Spearman rho(log {nm}, feasible) = {rho:+.3f}")

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12.5,4.8))
ax=axes[0]
xs=np.logspace(np.log10(0.5),np.log10(100),200)   # acetate/acetyl-CoA
for r,c in zip((1,3,5,10),["#2a7fbf","#4c956c","#e8a33d","#d1495b"]):
    ax.plot(xs,[K_HI/( (x)*r ) for x in xs], color=c, label=f"ATP/ADP = {r}")
ax.set_xscale("log"); ax.set_yscale("log")
ax.set_xlabel("[acetate] / [acetyl-CoA]")
ax.set_ylabel("maximum permissible [CoA] / [Pi]")
ax.axhspan(0.05/30, 2.0/2.0, color="grey", alpha=0.15)
ax.text(0.7,0.35,"plausible organellar\nCoA/Pi band", fontsize=8, color="0.3")
ax.set_title("Net ASCT/SCS cycle: feasibility boundary\n(above a line = no net ATP, below = net ATP)", fontsize=10)
ax.legend(fontsize=8, frameon=False)

ax=axes[1]
ax.hist(np.log10(Q), bins=120, color="#2a7fbf", edgecolor="none")
ax.axvline(np.log10(K_LO), color="k", ls="--", lw=1.2)
ax.axvline(np.log10(K_HI), color="k", ls="-", lw=1.2)
ax.text(np.log10(K_HI)+0.1, ax.get_ylim()[1]*0.9, f"K' = 1.42-2.33\n{frac_hi*100:.0f} % of sampled\nstates to the left", fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlabel("log10 Q  for  acetyl-CoA + ADP + Pi -> acetate + CoA + ATP")
ax.set_ylabel("sampled states")
ax.set_title(f"Monte Carlo over mitochondrial metabolite ranges (n={N:,})\nQ < K' is the condition for net ATP", fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
